import os, sys, torch, torch.distributed as dist, torch.multiprocessing as mp
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))))
from transformers import LlamaConfig, LlamaForCausalLM
from pipeline_parallel import train_step_pipeline_afab
import torch.nn.functional as F

def make():
    torch.manual_seed(0)
    cfg = LlamaConfig(vocab_size=128, hidden_size=64, intermediate_size=128, num_hidden_layers=5,
                      num_attention_heads=4, num_key_value_heads=2)
    return LlamaForCausalLM(cfg).float()

def run(rank, ws):
    os.environ.update(MASTER_ADDR="127.0.0.1", MASTER_PORT=str(29510+ws))
    dist.init_process_group("gloo", rank=rank, world_size=ws)
    model = make(); ref = make()
    torch.manual_seed(1)
    inputs = [torch.randint(0,128,(2,16)) for _ in range(3)]
    targets = [torch.randint(0,128,(2,16)) for _ in range(3)]
    loss = train_step_pipeline_afab(model, inputs, targets, torch.device("cpu"), torch.float32)
    rl = 0
    for x,t in zip(inputs,targets):
        l = F.cross_entropy(ref(x).logits.reshape(-1,128), t.reshape(-1))/3
        l.backward(); rl += l.item()
    maxd = 0; n=0
    for (nm,p),(_,q) in zip(model.named_parameters(), ref.named_parameters()):
        if p.grad is not None:
            n+=1; maxd = max(maxd,(p.grad-q.grad).abs().max().item())
    print(f"ws={ws} rank={rank} loss={loss} ref={rl:.5f} params_with_grad={n} maxdiff={maxd:.2e}")
    dist.destroy_process_group()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    for ws in (1,2):
        mp.spawn(run, args=(ws,), nprocs=ws)
